artifact_note.target: A complete, tunable Scenario 01 dataset shared unchanged by GitHub Pages, PnP PDF, and Tabletop Simulator exporters.
artifact_note.assumptions: Values marked prototype_assumption are implementation choices required to make the GDD's unresolved mechanics playable. They are not GDD canon.
acceptance: Three actions per crew turn and five-card hand
Explore, search, fight, loot, noise, Threat, corpse feeding, chrysalis evolution, retreat and extraction are exercised
No exporter contains independent game balance/rules data

thresholds.effect: Spawn one Small Spider in the nearest revealed empty room.
Spawn one Large Spider in the nearest revealed empty room.
The expedition is overrun; crew must extract this round or lose.

noise.value: After a noisy attack, add its Noise to Threat. If an unrevealed adjacent room exists, reveal its encounter.

ammo.value: Ammo is a shared counter. Firearms spend listed ammo; Reload cards restore ammo.

search.value: Each searchable room can be searched once; draw one salvage card.

spider_feeding.value: At Enemy phase, a spider sharing a room with a Spider Corpse may consume one. Small becomes Fed (+1 max/current Health); Large becomes Fed and heals 1 each End phase. A Fed spider consuming a second corpse becomes a Chrysalis. Chrysalis hatches next End phase: Small lineage → Large; Large lineage → Alpha.

retreat.value: From Entrance, spend 1 action to extract. Extracted crew keep salvage. Scenario succeeds only after the Ancient Relay is activated and at least one crew extracts.

enemies.name: Small Spider

enemies.name: Large Spider
enemies.ai: Pursue nearest injured crew; feed on corpse in room before moving; retreat one room after feeding if possible.

enemies.name: Alpha Spider

scenario.name: The Cave
setup: Shuffle remaining room cards; place Ancient Relay in bottom 3 cards.
Each player chooses one crew role and its 10-card starter deck.
Set shared Ammo to 8, Scrap to 0, Threat to 0.
scenario.objective: Explore the cave system, recover the Ancient Power Cell, activate the Ancient Relay, and return at least one crew member to the Cave Mouth alive.
scenario.win: Ancient Relay activated and at least one crew extracts.
loss: Threat reaches 12 and no crew extracts before the end of that round.
scenario.provenance: GDD objective/teaching/target with prototype-specific Power Cell + Relay win implementation.
